response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr >= 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, matched_count, matched_count::numeric / SUM(matched_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction_of_order_type_total FROM grouped ORDER BY fraction_of_order_type_total DESC LIMIT 10;
